description: This file defines an interface IChainedGrain for Orleans grains with methods for chaining and validation, as well as a serializable class ChainGrainHolder holding a reference to IChainedGrain.

classes.name: ChainGrainHolder
classes.description: A serializable class holding a reference to an IChainedGrain, used for nested chaining.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the next grain in the chain.

methods.name: GetCalculatedValue
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a calculated value, marked as ReadOnly.

methods.name: SetNext
methods.description: Sets the next grain in the chain.

methods.name: SetNextNested
methods.description: Sets the next grain using a nested holder.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the chain, possibly checking if next is set.

methods.name: PassThis
methods.description: Passes the current grain to the next.

methods.name: PassNull
methods.description: Passes null to the next grain.

methods.name: PassThisNested
methods.description: Passes the nested holder to the next.

methods.name: PassNullNested
methods.description: Passes null to the nested holder.
